Read the pinned diagnostic config and report for early-console and boot-argument hypotheses; only standard options were selected for MiSeed, with no reference config or runtime claims imported. This bring-up pass also references the pinned Umi early-board support set to select SM8250 clocks, RPMh power domains, interconnect, SMMU, PMIC arbiter, and large fbcon font/rotation options; no upstream DTS/config file is copied into the project. Original compile assessment is archived at docs/archive/research/2026-11-08-upstream-power-port.md. Runtime adaptations and scoped local L3 are recorded at docs/archive/hardware/2026-11-08-umi-runtime-power.md; source reports and local hardware evidence remain separate.
